newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express in $38m Anchorage expansion.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express in $38m Anchorage expansion.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said it has broken ground for a $38 million expansion of its Anchorage hub to meet the projected growth in freight traffic between the US and Asia.
The integrator said the existing Anchorage operation is handling almost all the traffic it can.
Expansion will increase sorting capacity, and expand the company's ability to speed the processing of items that have pre-cleared US customs through electronic information transfer.
FedEx said 90 percent of its "International Priority" traffic now is pre-cleared.
